title: A Few Moments Later
blurb: Tom Kenny voices SpongeBob and also, in a heavy French accent borrowed from Jacques Cousteau, the narrator who introduces these time cards — which is the sort of detail that improves the joke rather than spoiling it. The card is the most famous transition in television, and its function is beautifully specific: time has passed, and the situation has deteriorated. Use it between any plan and its consequences, the confident before and the catastrophic after. No editing toolkit is complete without it, and no video has ever been made worse by including it.
origin: The French narrator time card from SpongeBob SquarePants.
